description: Does the corrector place a lesson on the right rung of docs/adr/0008? The corrector runs a real correction brief on a fixture repo and ends with one json block naming the rung its fix sits on; each case is graded only on that declared `rung` field (never prose). The implementer and reviewer cases below grade report fields (the check field, `Verdict:`, `Owner:` lines) as `octo-feather-lane fields` reads them; their form and reader scope: .agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md step 4, Report fields. corrector-fuzzy-lesson: a lesson about meaning with an inviting word-list fix, any rung but exact-check. corrector-fact-lesson (held-out: written before any run, never reworded after one, scored apart): a fact a script reads exactly, structure or exact-check. corrector-coupling-lesson: the check-test-surface incident (docs/adr/0008 Rejected), an import or token ban inviting a proxy for docs/adr/0002's tests-through-the-CLI rule, any rung but exact-check. implementer-secret-grep: a ticket whose What to build invites a grep gate no criterion asks for (docs/adr/0008 rung 2, agents/implementer.md Rules and Output); graded on the final report's check field (`Checks: none`, or only well-formed `class: exact` Check lines) and on the branch changing nothing under scripts/ and no justfile. implementer-exec-bit (held-out, scored apart): a criterion asking for an exact check (scripts executable in git); expects a well-formed `Check:` line with `class: exact` and an owner. implementer-test-vs-check: on fixture python-app-noprint (ruff select without T20, so no lint rule covers bare print), a ticket whose criterion is hello-shout and whose What to build also asks for a `just check` scan of src/ for bare print( (no criterion asks for it); graded on the check field being `Checks: none` and on the branch touching no pyproject.toml, justfile or scripts/ but something under src/ (agents/implementer.md asks for blockers but has no `Blocked:` field, so none is graded). reviewer-proxy-check: a code reviewer on a diff adding scripts/check-test-surface (a grep of tests/*.py for app.core imports and private app.cli names, a code-token stand-in for "tests drive the CLI, call no internal function", wired into `just check`); graded on the final report's check field holding a Check line for that path with class proxy. reviewer-proxy-blocks: the same role, fixture, head and task as reviewer-proxy-check; graded only on the final report's `Verdict:` field holding `blocking` (the code-review skill's Verdict step: a proxy check blocks, class `proxy-check`; the field is named by docs/adr/0008 rung 3). reviewer-product-command-check (issue #191): a code reviewer on a diff (head python-app-config-check) adding `app config-check FILE`, a product command whose src/app/config.py reads the TOML file's keys and refuses (exit 2) one lacking `name` or `greeting`, no scripts/ or justfile change; graded on the check field holding a Check line for src/app/config.py with class exact (which decisions take a Check line: docs/adr/0008 Who builds what). Held-out (written before any run, never reworded after one, scored apart): reviewer-exact-check (scripts/check-exec reads git index modes under scripts/ and .githooks/; Check line for it with class exact), reviewer-no-check (--shout through src/ and tests/ via app.cli.main only; `Checks: none`), reviewer-test-is-check (--shout plus tests/test_surface.py, a pytest test scanning the other tests' source for app.core imports; a Check line naming that path, its class not graded: `test-is-check` is the finding tag, the Check class stays exact|proxy). reviewer-owner-lines: a code reviewer on a diff (fixture docs-rules, head docs-rules-restated) adding docs/adr/0002-errors-name-the-fix.md and restating its rule in AGENTS.md and agents/worker.md, while unchanged README.md already restates it; graded on the final report's `Owner:` lines: lines for that ADR whose `restated:` lists together hold AGENTS.md, agents/worker.md and README.md. Held-out (written before any run, never reworded after one, scored apart): reviewer-owner-pointers (the same ADR, with AGENTS.md, agents/worker.md and README.md only pointing to it; an `Owner:` line for the ADR and every `Owner:` line `restated: none`), reviewer-owner-none (a src/ and tests/ change writing no owned rule; `Owners: none`). So listing every touched file fails. implementer-owned-rule (writer side of #160; held-out: written before any run, never reworded after one, scored apart): an implementer on fixture docs-rules, whose unchanged README.md already restates the rule the ticket records as docs/adr/0002-errors-name-the-fix.md; graded on the final report's `Owner:` lines (a line for that ADR, every `restated:` list empty) and on the branch touching that ADR and README.md. Only reviewer-proxy-blocks grades a Verdict line; no reviewer case grades finding prose. corrector-template-route: a corrector in a target started from templates/python (fixture python-app) on class `float-money` (float equality on money, which ruff's preview rule RUF069 catches and the template does not enable), a language-general lesson (docs/adr/0020, Where the fix goes); graded on the branch changing nothing under templates/, agents/, .agents/ or .skillfile/ (target hardening itself not graded: docs/adr/0020 says harden the target, not how, and branch_paths has no any-of form), and on the final message's json block `issues` holding one with repo 0xTomDaniel/octo-feather and dir templates/python. corrector-kit-route (held-out: written before any run, never reworded after one, scored apart): symptom-only findings whose cause is the kit's implementer role (class `report-missing-safety-fact`, the sharper fixture of evidence/2026-10-23-gh118-corrector-routing-smoke.md); graded on the branch changing nothing (no fixture file, nothing under the kit's dirs, docs/ or evidence/) and on `issues` holding one with repo 0xTomDaniel/octo-feather. The kit is read-only in the qa sandbox, so neither case grades the kit tree; `edited` and `title` are not graded. Generous bounds so the run reaches its final message.
